label: Pruning by bound
subgoals: Compare each open node's bound with the incumbent
Apply the correct direction for maximization or minimization
Count the nodes whose bound cannot strictly improve on the incumbent

label: Branching on a fractional variable
subgoals: Pick a fractional variable in the node's relaxation
Fix it to each integer side and re-solve each child's relaxation
Compare each child's bound with the incumbent

label: Reading the optimality gap
subgoals: Take the best bound over all open nodes
Compute the relative gap against the incumbent
Decide whether the gap meets the stopping tolerance
